title: Chapter 467: Battle Against Queen Anna
content:
Chapter 467: Battle Against Queen Anna

No matter what profession you are in, once you are promoted to the strongest king, you will gain the ability to fly for a short time.

Of course, it is still impossible to travel long distances by flying.

Because the consumption of long-term flying is very huge.

In the opposite camp, a group of kings also walked out.

Queen Anna walked in front of Wang Shuo intentionally or unintentionally.

Wang Shuo also had this intention, and couldn't help but smile.

Some time ago, Wang Shuo was still wondering that the Great Huai Domain had been exposed for a while, and this Queen Anna had not come to trouble him, which was obviously not in line with her ruthless style.

Now it seems that she should be too busy to take care of herself, and the Truni Empire should also be constantly at war, so she has no time to take care of herself.

"Oh, the little friend back then has become a king now! Awesome, awesome!" Queen Anna smiled and her voice was soft.

But Wang Shuo felt a chill.

Because Anna is a humanoid spider.

Although it has a human torso, it has eight legs behind it.

Anna can also put away her extra legs and become a normal person.

But obviously, she doesn't like to do this.

Wang Shuo shrugged his nose, pouted and said: "Queen Anna, you look so ugly!"

Wang Shuo's seemingly indifferent words were like a drop of water in a hot pot.

Anna instantly exploded and let out a shrill howl.

"Squeak..."

Before the sound disappeared, Anna launched an attack.

Wang Shuo heard the howl and was briefly absent-minded.

It turned out that Anna's howl was accompanied by a mental attack.

But it didn't have much effect on Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo also drew out the Shura Demon-Breaking Spear, erected it on the ground, and then kicked it with his right foot. The long spear swung in the air until the tip of the spear was facing Anna.

Wang Shuo moved his feet and rushed towards Anna quickly.

As the strongest king, Wang Shuo also had the Shura bonus, so he was not afraid at all, even though Anna was an old monster from 1,000 years ago.

And the other strongest kings also fought with their respective opponents.

Ye Hui and Andre clashed their swords, each took a step back, and then rushed towards each other again.

…

Every time Wang Shuo attacked, a dragon-shaped phantom would be attached.

The dragon-shaped phantom of the ordinary big move was much more powerful than before.

Each attack could repel one of Anna's spider legs.

This shocked Anna.

Strength really has nothing to do with age.

Anna had put away her contempt.

Suddenly, Anna howled again, and then the eight spider legs behind her flew towards Wang Shuo like eight sharp short spears.

The sound of breaking through the air sounded, and even sound waves were generated.

Wang Shuo's pupils suddenly shrank, and his expression was serious.

It seemed that Anna had used some powerful skills.

Wang Shuo was not too worried about how much damage this attack could cause him.

After all, there was absolute defense and blocking of fatal blows.

Wang Shuo wanted to try whether he could use a spear to block this powerful move.

In a very short time, Wang Shuo used four skills in succession: "Directly Attacking the Yellow Dragon", "Flying Dragon in the Sky", "Dragon Out of the Sea" and "Dragon Strike".

After practicing "Dragon Spear Art" to the peak, Wang Shuo was able to use these skills very easily.

The eight bone spears were knocked away one by one.

Anna looked at her skills and was easily blocked by Wang Shuo, and became even more angry.

The eight spider legs that had just been broken quickly grew out again, exactly the same as before, still shining with a cold light.

She shot out countless spider silks again, trying to tie up Wang Shuo.
